news.title: IWG signs 43 new locations in India in H1 2026; country becomes third-largest growth market
news.para: International Workplace Group signed 43 new locations in India during H1 2026, making the country its third-largest growth market globally. The company currently operates 125 centres across 37 Indian cities and has more than 200 centres in the pipeline.

news.title: Patna civic bodu collects ₹93 lakh property tax in one-day drive
news.para: In a significant revenue boost, Patna Municipal Corporation collected upwards of Rs 93 lakh in property tax on Tuesday, with the Patliputra circle contributing Rs 67.99 lakh from 129 properties. To identify untaxed homes, officials engaged in door-to-door outreach and site checks. Property owners should note that taxes must be paid by September 30 to sidestep penalties.

news.title: Chandigarh housing board set to widen scope of need-based changes for independent homes
news.para: The Chandigarh Housing Board is set to introduce enhanced rebuilding options for independent house owners. Under new regulations, homeowners may now have the option to demolish and reconstruct their residences, a notable shift in policy. The allowable covered area may rise from fifty to seventy percent to align with other house types. Additionally, lifts may be installed to boost accessibility, reflecting the objective of adapting to modern living standards.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh CM to distribute 26,426 house site pattas in Visakhapatnam on September 19
news.para: The Andhra Pradesh government is set to launch a major house-site pattas distribution in Visakhapatnam. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu is slated to hand over 26,426 regularisation pattas, providing legal status to homes constructed on government land of up to 100 square yards. The event, happening on September 19, marks a pivotal step towards securing property rights and supporting families in need.

news.title: HSVP offers Rs 494 crore relief to 421 Gurugram plot holders to settle enhancement disputes
news.para: The Vivadon Se Samadhan Yojana 2026 offers over Rs 494 crore in financial relief to those entangled in plot enhancement charge disputes. This opportunity is valid until December 31, 2026, for qualifying allottees. To find out their status, plot holders simply need to visit the HSVP portal. Remember, not taking advantage of this scheme may lead to plots being resumed as per established regulations.

news.title: Hazaribag mayor plans crackdown on unsafe hostels, apartments
news.para: Hazaribag Municipal Corporation is taking proactive measures by inspecting buildings throughout the city. Mayor Arvind Kumar Rana has directed a comprehensive review of safety and compliance across all structures, including those that are currently occupied and under construction. Any owners found with unauthorized plans or code violations will face penalties, particularly focusing on accommodations for students and tenants.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh gets three lakh, Telangana two lakh rural houses under PMAY-Gramin
news.para: The Centre allocated five lakh houses under PMAY-G to Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. Andhra Pradesh received three lakh houses, and Telangana received two lakh units. Beneficiaries will receive financial aid for construction and toilet facilities. Previous government completed only twenty-three percent of sanctioned houses. Fresh allocations will accelerate rural housing and benefit many families.

news.title: Odisha RERA freezes bank accounts of 28 promoters for QPR default
news.para: The Odisha Real Estate Regulatory Authority has taken decisive action by freezing the bank accounts of twenty-eight real estate promoters who did not submit their required Quarterly Progress Reports. This decision is part of a broader initiative to enhance financial transparency and ensure accountability, ultimately protecting homebuyers from potential fraud. Industry insiders think this serves as a crucial warning to others in the real estate market.

news.title: DDA holds stakeholder conference for Delhi master plan 2047
news.para: The Delhi Development Authority convened a meeting with industry leaders to deliberate on the Master Plan of Delhi 2047. Key topics included encouraging industrial growth and enhancing land allocation for the private sector. Additionally, the plan outlines frameworks for Institutional Social Responsibility. Resident welfare associations received updates on redevelopment policies for older housing societies, all aimed at promoting future growth and modernization throughout Delhi.

news.title: MCD carries out 40 demolitions, seals 16 properties in Delhi
news.para: On Tuesday, the Municipal Corporation of Delhi ramped up its campaign against hazardous and illegal constructions, carrying out forty demolitions and sealing sixteen properties. Significant actions took place in areas such as Satbari, Vishal Enclave, and Subzi Mandi. This stringent enforcement comes after eight properties were sealed on Monday due to violations of building codes, with the drive set to persist against non-compliant structures.

news.title: Veegaland Developers IPO subscribed 13.55 times
news.para: Veegaland Developers' initial public offering attracted remarkable investor enthusiasm, culminating in an impressive 13.55 times subscription on the last day of bidding. Notably, both non-institutional and qualified institutional buyers demonstrated exceptional demand, subscribing over 17 times their available shares. Retail investors also actively participated, achieving a subscription rate of 9.24 times. The funds generated will be utilized for ongoing projects and future land acquisitions.

news.title: Rehabilitation colony ownership move closer to reality, Chandigarh administration sends rules to centre
news.para: Chandigarh's administration has presented draft rules to the Union home ministry for endorsement. These regulations intend to establish ownership rights for residents of rehabilitation colonies deemed eligible. The original allotment letters will act as the fundamental basis for determining ownership. This initiative comes in response to decades of residents advocating for clarity and resolution concerning their property rights in Chandigarh.

news.title: Nila Spaces to invest over ₹1,600 crore in two projects in GIFT City
news.para: Nila Spaces is investing upwards of ₹1,600 crore across its two ongoing projects, Vida and Prana, in GIFT City, said Deep Vadodaria, managing director, Nila Spaces. The company has also introduced IKEA-designed and furnished ready-to-live home options for buyers at Vida.

news.title: Over 100 owners remove stilt violations ahead of enforcement drive in Gurugram
news.para: Property owners are voluntarily removing illegal structures from stilt areas. This action follows a crackdown on unauthorized construction and commercialization by authorities. Over one hundred owners have submitted visual evidence of their compliance efforts. The department of town and planning is verifying these voluntary removals. Enforcement action continues against properties where violations remain.

news.title: K-nest Construction Tech expands into DeepTech with indigenous construction automation technologies
news.para: Company brings robotics, 3D construction printing, human augmentation, precision sensing and automated high-rise construction systems into its technology portfolio

news.title: Higher price tags for Bhubaneswar development body's homes; middle class in a fix
news.para: The Bhubaneswar Development Authority has transitioned its housing projects towards luxury amenities, resulting in a sharp increase in prices. This change is leaving many middle-income families struggling to afford homes in the city, as apartment sizes fail to keep pace with soaring costs. Factors such as rising land values and construction expenses are driving these price hikes, though the authority plans to roll out affordable housing options soon.

news.title: CBRE South Asia to integrate Propstack’s real estate analytics platform
news.para: Propstack has entered into a strategic enterprise agreement with CBRE South Asia. Under the partnership, CBRE will integrate Propstack’s data and analytics platform across its India operations to support market intelligence, investment analysis and client advisory.
